project: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Dancing with the SARs
phase: 4B.1: Reference Ingestion Scientific Corrections and Acquisition Readiness

sentinel2_scl_correction.issue: SCL class 2 was previously described as Cast Shadow / cloud shadow and potentially conflated with water or cloud shadows.
sentinel2_scl_correction.correction: SCL class 2 is explicitly classified as Dark Area Pixels (uncertain dark-area observation, NOT cloud shadow, NOT water). Class 3 is specifically Cloud Shadows. Class 0 is true NoData (value 255). Classes 7-10 are Cloud/Cirrus (value 254). Class 1 is Saturated/Defective (value 251). Class 11 is Snow/Ice (value 250). Clear classes 4, 5, 6 are preserved.
sentinel2_scl_correction.implementation: SCLMaskResult object implemented with dedicated boolean masks (dark_area_mask, cloud_shadow_mask, etc.) while unpacking as (clear_mask, uncertain_mask) for backward compatibility.

sentinel2_reflectance_scaling.issue: BOA_ADD_OFFSET was previously hardcoded or defaulted without dynamic per-band parsing or baseline verification.
sentinel2_reflectance_scaling.correction: Implemented validate_sentinel2_scaling_metadata. Processing Baseline is read from metadata. Baseline >= 04.00 requires explicit per-band offsets (e.g. B03, B08, B11, B12). Baseline < 04.00 defaults offsets to 0.0 unless specified. Inconsistent or missing metadata triggers validation failure.
sentinel2_reflectance_scaling.implementation: parse_and_validate_s2_scaling_metadata integrated into ingestion and validation pipelines.

landsat_resolution_and_radsat.issue: Resampling 30m Landsat reflective bands to the 20m SAR grid risked misinterpreting upsampled pixels as genuine 20m optical ground truth.
landsat_resolution_and_radsat.correction: Preserved native 30m resolution metadata. Resampling is explicitly documented as introducing point spread function smoothing and spatial covariance without generating 20m optical ground information. QA_RADSAT saturation in B3, B5, and B6 is incorporated into quality masking. Added aggregate_validation_to_blocks for 60m common support comparison.
landsat_resolution_and_radsat.implementation: mask_landsat_qa_pixel updated with qa_radsat_array; spatial_support dictionary added to outputs.

copernicus_dem_terminology.issue: Copernicus GLO-30 was previously described as a DEM without documenting canopy/building surface artifacts.
copernicus_dem_terminology.correction: Accurately reclassified as a Digital Surface Model (DSM). Documented that elevations include forest canopy, char vegetation (3-15m), and structures, which create artificial dams across floodplains. Emphasized that HAND calculation is a future task requiring hydrologic conditioning and a calibrated drainage network.
copernicus_dem_terminology.implementation: dataset_type updated to Copernicus_GLO-30_DSM with explicit canopy bias and hydrological limitation warnings.

hydrological_datum_safety.issue: Generic 0-60m range check risked rejecting legitimate observations, and PWD/EGM2008 conversion lacked explicit protection.
hydrological_datum_safety.correction: Replaced hardcoded bounds check with configurable station-specific plausibility warnings (plausibility_range). Raw gauge observations are preserved unaltered. PWD and EGM2008 elevations are explicitly protected from conflation or unverified conversion without surveyed benchmark parameters.
hydrological_datum_safety.implementation: validate_hydrological_csv updated with plausibility_range and DATUM_INCOMPATIBILITY_PROTECTION.

required_modalities: BWDB / FFWC River Stage CSV (Stations SW46.9, SW46.9A)
